description:
Annotate a list of genes (up to 500 IDs or names) in one call: resolved ID, species, location, name, top
InterPro/Pfam domains, GO terms, Plant Reactome pathways and orthologues in the main related genomes
(['brassica_napus', 'brassica_rapa_ro18', 'brassica_oleracea', 'camelina_sativa', 'arabidopsis_thaliana']). For gene-list follow-up after an experiment (DE genes, GWAS candidates); the web
page genes.html (gene-list tab) runs this and downloads a TSV.
name: annotate_genes
